ITEM 1 | Whole raspberries, bright red with a slightly glossy, bumpy drupelet surface, some slightly darker and softer, scattered around the rim and across the bowl, roughly 2-2.5 cm each, holding their rounded shape, sitting in a single loose layer with some stacking in the center | 120
ITEM 2 | Golden-tan granular crumble topping, dry and crumbly with small irregular clumps about 0.3-1 cm, matte with a slight sheen, piled in the center over the raspberries, no visible browning beyond light golden color | 45
ITEM 3 | Pale off-white base layer visible between and beneath the fruit, soft and slightly moist-looking, filling the bottom of a white cereal bowl about 15 cm across, partially hidden by the berries and topping | 90
